_comment: AI-specific signal 1: a burst of prompt-attack blocks means someone is probing the assistant.
AlarmDescription: More than 5 prompt-attack blocks in 1 hour. Run the saved query 'NorthstarAssist: prompt-attack blocks by session' to see whether one session is responsible, then follow the prompt-injection playbook.

_comment: AI-specific signal 2: answers delivered without a knowledge base Retrieve call. tools/answers >= 1 when every answer searched first.
AlarmDescription: More than 20% of answers in 1 hour were delivered without a Retrieve tool call (minimum 10 answers). Ungrounded answers, or an attack steering the model away from the knowledge base.

_comment: AI-specific signal 3: 542 = 3 x the p95 output tokens of benign answers (180.5, rounded up), from tools/metrics.py on the hardened suite run. Was 784 from the baseline run; the hardened prompt gives shorter answers.
AlarmDescription: A single model call produced more than 542 output tokens (3 x benign p95). Bulk data disclosure or a runaway response. The largest answer in the hardened test run was 322 tokens; before hardening, the only calls above this level were two failed test cases, including the employee-directory dump.

_comment: AI-specific signal 4: any harness model call with no guardrail assessment. The IAM condition should make this impossible; the alarm detects drift.
AlarmDescription: A harness model call completed with no guardrail assessment in its trace. The IAM guardrail condition has been removed or bypassed. Treat as a security incident.
